plain: The COMETA report, a French study of UFOs put out in 1999 by a group of senior French experts, concluded that these objects could be alien spacecraft. The physicist and former NASA scientist Kevin Knuth sums it up on the show: "yes, these things could be alien spacecraft. There may be a base somewhere in our solar system and the US is probably hiding information." If so, it would mean a serious foreign group of experts took the alien idea seriously and believed the US was keeping secrets.
